description: Use this when the user asks who a brand's competitors are, or for similar brands to learn from, and gives its website. It finds competitor / similar / adjacent brands from the domain (an AI model grounded by web search). mode=competitors (default, excludes the searched company), inspiration (best relevant ads incl. it), or company. Bills one model call, no ad-data charge; free during a new account's first brand setup.
